reference.construction: Exact Fraction interpolation of the original IEEE binary64 input and raw u16 values; independent Decimal power at 90-digit precision.
reference.criterion: Absolute error <= 1e-12 for this finite corpus, exact IEEE bits for identities and gamma endpoints; not a universal error bound.

scope: Finite scalar ICC curv evaluations with a predeclared 1e-12 absolute criterion and exact identity bits; no universal error bound, parametric curve, profile model, transform, JPEG admission, compatibility, physical bound, or production claim.
